subject: Request: Move from annual prepay to quarterly billing (Helios Therapeutics)
messages:
From: Martin Lang <martin.lang@heliostx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract questions / billing cadence

Karthik —

Appreciate the walkthrough today. Procurement wants to avoid a large annual prepay this cycle due to internal cashflow timing. They asked if we can move Helios to quarterly invoicing instead of the annual prepay outlined in the SOW.

High level ask from their side: quarterly invoices with Net-60 payment terms. They also asked about a small concession on start-of-term pricing if we can accept the change (they suggested a 7.5% concession). I attached the PO request and the signed SOW that was initially exchanged.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept quarterly billing + Net-60 and what, if any, discount we can offer without routing to Finance/Execs?

Thanks,
Martin Lang
CFO, Helios Therapeutics
martin.lang@heliostx.com

Attachments: Helios_PO_Request.xlsx (xlsx), Signed_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Martin Lang <martin.lang@heliostx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract questions / billing cadence

Martin —

Thanks — I pulled the SOW and PO. Short answer: quarterly invoicing is not our default for new enterprise subscriptions (we typically require annual prepay for first-year commercial agreements). However, we do have precedent for making exceptions where procurement constraints are binding and credit risk is mitigated.

Proposed commercial compromise (seeking internal approval):
- Switch to quarterly invoicing for year 1, invoices issued at T0 and then every 90 days.
- Net-60 payment terms on invoices.
- Customer to pay first quarter invoice at signing (so 25% upfront) — reduces exposure.
- Offer a 5% one-time concession off list price for the first year in exchange for the cadence change.

If this sounds reasonable I need approval from Deal Desk / Revenue Ops and Finance for the Net-60 + 5% concession. I am looping Marissa (Head of Sales Ops) for deal-desk and PrIyom (Sales Finance) as well.

If approved, I will: 1) update the SOW with billing cadence and payment clause, 2) attach a short payment amendment for signature, 3) confirm the PO flow.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com

[Quoted original message]
> Attached: Helios_PO_Request.xlsx, Signed_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Move from annual prepay to quarterly billing (Helios Therapeutics)

Karthik / Priyom —

I reviewed the SOW and PO. Quick thoughts:
- I support moving to quarterly billing for this account given they are a high-quality biotech with a long-standing balance sheet; procurement timing seems genuine.
- We should tighten commercial protections: require first-quarter payment up front (as Karthik suggested) and run the customer through a standard credit check.
- Regarding the concession, I do not recommend 7.5%. Ops/Finance will likely accept 5% as an upper bound for a billing cadence exception. Anything larger will need VP approval.

Requesting formal signoff from Sales Finance (Priyom) on Net-60 exposure and from Finance/Revenue Ops on the 5% concession. Also flag Legal to ensure invoicing language and termination/collection remedies are present in the amendment.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Move from annual prepay to quarterly billing (Helios Therapeutics)

Marissa / Karthik —

I ran the numbers and discussed with Revenue Ops. Key points:
- Net-60 increases DSO exposure materially for a Q-billed subscription but first-quarter upfront payment will reduce near-term credit exposure by 25% (acceptable).
- We can approve a 5% one-time concession against list for the first year. That concession should be accounted for as a one-time adjustment in SFDC and be reflected in the amendment.
- Require a PO that references the amended SOW and the payment amendment. We prefer the PO be addressed to Redwood Inference, Inc. and route to AP for Net-60 processing.
- Legal needs to add a 14-day late fee grace + interest clause and a right-to-stop-services clause after 75 days past due. This is standard for any Net-60 arrangements.

I provisionally approve the change to quarterly billing + Net-60 with 5% concession, pending Legal language and a clean PO. If Legal comes back with material vetoes I'll re-open.

Priyom Das
Sales Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.inference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Martin Lang <martin.lang@heliostx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Move from annual prepay to quarterly billing (Helios Therapeutics)

Martin —

Good news: Redwood can accommodate the requested cadence with a couple of controls. Approved terms below: 

- Billing cadence: quarterly invoices (first invoice due on signature, subsequent invoices every ~90 days)
- Payment terms: Net-60 on all invoices
- Credit: first-quarter invoice due at signing (25% upfront)
- Commercial concession: 5% one-time reduction to the first-year invoice total
- Legal amendments: add standard late-fee (14-day grace) and right-to-stop-services after 75 days past due

Next steps for your team: please confirm the PO will reference the amended SOW and send it to procurement@heliostx.com addressed to Redwood Inference, Inc. Legal will push a short billing amendment to you for signature. Once we have the PO and the signed amendment, Finance will mark the account for quarterly invoicing.

Thanks for working with us on this — looping Marissa and Priyom on implementation details.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com

[Attachment: Billing_Amendment_Draft.docx (docx) - to be sent by Legal]
